messages:
sam: Quick sync 1: were running a localized communications drill ahead of Tue 2026-06-01 maintenance (00:00-03:00 UTC). Scope: kernel patches on Dedicated + runtime pin refresh. Need final status page snippet and SMS blurb. Who can review single-pass now?

maria: I can. I drafted two lengths: short status line and a detailed customer email. Pasting both.

maria: ```
Status (short):
Planned maintenance: Tue 2026-06-01 00:0000:00 UTC. Applying kernel updates and runtime pinning. Brief latency spikes possible; no expected downtime. Live updates on status page.
```

maria: ```
Email (detailed):
Hello,
We will conduct planned maintenance on Tue 2026-06-01 from 00:00 to 03:00 UTC to apply kernel patches and refresh runtime version pins on Dedicated clusters. During this window you may observe brief latency increases for in-flight requests. We do not expect service interruption. We will run post-maint smoke tests and publish a success marker.

Actions in this window:
- Kernel patching on Dedicated hosts
- Runtime pin bump and config refresh
- KV cache priming (non-disruptive)

If your app depends on tight tail-latency guarantees or a pinned model variant, reply and we will coordinate a temporary hold.

Regards,
Redwood Platform
```

support-jordan: Suggestions:
- Add an SMS fallback paragraph for opt-ins with local time formatting
- Add one-sentence note for embeddings customers: billing/tokens unaffected
- Include a short reassurance about data residency: "No changes to data residency or exports expected."

ops-maya: Also recommend a post-maint validation note: "We will run a cross-region smoke-check and post results" so CS has a clear triage signal.

legal-ella: Small wording request 1: change any absolute claims. Use "not expected" rather than "no downtime". Also keep rollback description high-level.

sam: Acknowledged. I'll update the drafts: add SMS blurb, embeddings note, data residency sentence, switch to "not expected" phrasing, and add a brief rollback plan mention.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: maintenance ticket MAINT-20260601-01 scheduled; will post automated updates every 15m during the window and close 30m after successful smoke checks.

maria: Updated drafts in internal doc: /docs/maintenance/mainti-1765432101-bulletin-draft.md (internal link) https://redwood.internal/docs/maintenance/mainti-1765432101-bulletin-draft

sam: Translation plan: publish EN + FR + DE for the drill; JP/KR will be pending. Maria can do FR/DE. Who can cover JP/KR or shall we send to vendor (adds lead time)?

support-jordan: I'll queue SMS for EU recipients at 01:00 UTC with local time strings. Will post CSV to ops channel.

ops-maya: Preflight checklist: I'll run smoke checks 30m before and post results. Ops sign-off once checks pass.

maria: Draft for SMS (EU opt-ins): "Redwood planned maintenance Tue 01 Jun 00:00-03:00 UTC. Brief latency may occur. Details: https://status.redwood.ai/MAINT-20260601 (DRILL)."

sam: Good. One more: add an embeddings-specific line for the status page snippet: "Embedding requests unaffected for billing and tokens." Keep it short.

statusbot: Status update posted (DRILL): https://status.redwood.ai/incident/MAINT-20260601-drill. Initial message live.

sam: Publishing EN + FR + DE drill entries now. Will mark JP/KR pending. If no objections I will trigger SMS at 01:00 UTC and proceed with the ops drill.

legal-ella: Approved, wording looks good.

support-jordan: SMS queued and validated; will confirm after send.

ops-maya: Ops checks green; ready for drill. Will monitor and post smoke result markers during the window.

sam: Thanks team. Closing out here; will reopen if translation or SLA flags surface. Reopen if you need edit access to the status page entry.
